introduction: New York Temporary Assistance includes Family Assistance and Safety Net Assistance. Local districts assess regular and emergency requests.
description: New York Temporary Assistance includes Family Assistance and Safety Net Assistance. Local districts assess regular and emergency requests.

sections.who: Financial, household and program conditions apply. Work activities or other cooperation requirements may affect a case.
sections.get: Assistance can support basic needs; emergency help may address qualifying urgent costs. The district determines the form and amount.
sections.docs:
• Identity and household records.
  • Income and shelter-cost evidence.
  • Emergency notices and requested eligibility records.
sections.apply:
1. Choose local intake

    Use myBenefits or contact the district; NYC applicants use ACCESS HRA.

  2. Explain emergencies

    State the immediate need and deadlines to a worker.

  3. Complete the interview

    Follow local document and activity instructions.
sections.after: Read decisions and hearing instructions. Ask about exceptions or safety concerns with required activities.
sections.sources: Content checked October 1, 2026 using State assistance application portal; NYC cash assistance; OTDA assistance overview. Current eligibility and the final decision remain with the program.
